mechanism: Rifampin is a potent CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 inducer that increases ranitidine metabolism, reducing its serum concentrations and gastric acid suppression efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced ranitidine efficacy; consider increasing ranitidine dose or switching to an alternative H2-blocker less affected by enzyme induction such as famotidine, or use a proton pump inhibitor which may have more stable levels.
